20_messages.content: Hey Maya! How are you doing today?
Hey! Pretty good, just sipping an iced pour-over and editing photos. How is your day going?
Just finished a marathon meeting at work. Brain is completely fried.
Ugh, meeting marathons are the worst. You definitely deserve a break! Go grab some fresh air.
Totally. Working on an open-source AI platform now to unwind.
Oh nice! What stack are you using for it? Frontend or backend focus?
React frontend with Vite and Tailwind, FastAPI with MongoDB on the backend.
That is such a clean stack. Building the character personalities must be the best part.
Yeah, getting the system prompt to sound natural instead of like a customer support bot was tricky.
Seriously! Getting conversational warmth without boilerplate AI phrases is an art form.
We also built a memory compaction system so chats do not blow up context windows.
That is smart. Caching summaries of older turns keeps the chat snappy and affordable.
What kind of hobbies do you do when you are not designing?
Street photography and urban cycling! Tokyo golden hours have incredible light.
Awesome! What camera do you shoot on?
A Fujifilm X-T4. The color science right out of the box is unbeatable.
Love Fujifilm! Do you use film simulations like Classic Chrome?
Yes! Classic Chrome with warmth dialed in is basically my default recipe.
Any big weekend plans coming up?
Riding down to the coastal pier and hitting this tiny ramen shop in Shimokitazawa.
